title: Core: Paint bucket fill tool
description: Implement applyPaintBucket(doc, sceneIdx, layerIdx, frameIdx, objectId, fillColor) in packages/core/src/engine/paintbucket.ts. Finds the target ShapeDisplayObject and replaces the fill color on all its ShapePaths. Similar to inkbottle but for fill. Export from engine/index.ts. Tests: apply fill, replace existing fill, no-op for missing object.
